sn37.13:1.1: pañcahi anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa …pe… nirayaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.13:1.3: assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottappī ca hoti muṭṭhassati ca hoti duppañño ca hoti.
sn37.13:1.4: imehi kho anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa …pe… nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
